name: Dr. Kwabena Mensah
title: Founding Director
bio: Former development banker who spent two decades financing African SMEs. He founded ASBS to close the gap between sustainability policy and the daily decisions business owners actually make.

name: Amara Okonkwo
title: Director of Programmes
bio: Spent twelve years advising manufacturing cooperatives on resource efficiency before joining ASBS. She designs the curriculum around what participants can implement within a single financial quarter.

name: Daniel Obeng
title: Head of Agribusiness Faculty
bio: An agricultural economist who worked with smallholder cooperatives across East and West Africa. He leads the field-based delivery of the Regenerative Agribusiness programme.

name: Grace Mwaura
title: Head of Finance Faculty
bio: Former impact investment analyst who now teaches finance leads how to structure green finance applications that lenders actually approve.
